text: {"lessons":["My account has declined overall, so I should keep retirement security and limiting large losses central to my decisions.","I sold the same number of shares in every stock, including Stock C at a large loss; future trades should reflect each holding’s risks and my overall plan, not use a one-size-fits-all rule.","A gain or loss compared with my purchase price alone does not tell me whether to keep a stock; I should make calm decisions based on current prospects and the role each holding plays in my portfolio."]}
